name: n8n-hubspot-ticket-sla-escalation-router
description: n8n workflow that monitors open HubSpot tickets, evaluates first-response and resolution SLAs by priority tier, and escalates neglected tickets via HubSpot tasks, Slack and email.
author: DH Robin (dhRobin Systems)

scripts.lint: node --check src/config.js && node --check src/slaEngine.js && node --check scripts/build-workflow.js && node --check tests/slaEngine.test.js && node --check tests/workflow.test.js && node -e "JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync('workflow.json','utf8'))"
scripts.ci: npm run lint && npm run build:check && npm test
